title: Government's Response to the Report of the Committee of Inquiry into the Cyberattack on SingHealth's IT System
what_it_is: Government's Response to the Report of the Committee of Inquiry into the Cyberattack on SingHealth's IT System

sections.label: SingHealth patient data breach
sections.summary: About 1.5 million patients' personal particulars were illegally accessed and copied, with Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong's records specifically targeted.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The personal particulars of about 1.5 million patients were illegally accessed and copied.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong's records were specifically and repeatedly targeted.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: And there were serious implications for public health and safety, as SingHealth's database system is part of our Critical Information Infrastructure (CII).

sections.label: COI classified report submission
sections.summary: The COI submitted its classified report to the speaker on 31 December 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The COI submitted its classified report to me on 31 December 2018.

sections.label: COI findings on attack
sections.summary: The COI found SingHealth fell victim to an Advanced Persistent Threat group, but the attacker's success was not inevitable.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The COI has been candid in its report, which establishes the sophisticated nature of the attacker, but also gives a detailed and stark account of shortcomings at the staff and systems level that contributed to the failure to prevent the attack or limit its impact.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Specifically, the COI found that while SingHealth fell victim to an Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) group, the success of the attacker in obtaining and exfiltrating the data was not inevitable.

sections.label: COI recommendations for databases
sections.summary: The COI made 16 recommendations, seven priority and nine additional, to strengthen SingHealth and public sector IT systems.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The COI has made 16 recommendations to strengthen SingHealth's patient databases, as well as public sector IT systems which contain large databases of personal data.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Seven are priority recommendations which should be implemented immediately, and nine are additional recommendations which are to be seriously considered.

sections.label: Adopting COI recommendations
sections.summary: The government will fully adopt the COI's recommendations to secure IT and database systems and protect personal data.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Cybersecurity is a critical enabler of our Smart Nation ambitions.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: We will, therefore, fully adopt the COI's recommendations and do our utmost to ensure that our IT and database systems are secure, and that personal data collected by Government systems is well-protected.

sections.label: Act commencement and CII designation
sections.summary: The Act came into force on 31 August last year and CSA designated all CIIs by 31 December last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The Act came into force on 31 August last year and CSA designated all CIIs by 31 December last year.

sections.label: SNDGG pauses Government systems rollout
sections.summary: SNDGG paused new Government systems rollout from 20 July to 3 August 2018 and checked other systems were not breached by the same attacker.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Upon discovering the cyberattack, SNDGG paused the rollout of new Government systems from 20 July to 3 August 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: During this pause, first, SNDGG checked and confirmed that other systems were not breached by the same attacker, whether through the IHiS system or via a separate breach.

sections.label: Government Bug Bounty Programme launched
sections.summary: GovTech and CSA launched a Government Bug Bounty Programme inviting white-hat hackers to uncover vulnerabilities on five Internet-facing Government systems and websites.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The Government Technology Agency (GovTech) and CSA have launched a Government Bug Bounty Programme, and have invited local and international white-hat hackers to search for and uncover vulnerabilities on five Internet-facing Government systems and websites.

sections.label: PDPC penalties on IHiS and SingHealth
sections.summary: IHiS and SingHealth breached the Personal Data Protection Act, and PDPC imposed S$750,000 and S$250,000 penalties respectively, its highest to date.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Both IHiS and SingHealth have been found to be in breach of the Personal Data Protection Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: PDPC has imposed a total financial penalty of S$1 million, comprising S$750,000 and S$250,000 on IHiS and SingHealth respectively.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: These are the highest penalties meted out by PDPC to date.

sections.label: SingHealth patient data illegally accessed
sections.summary: The cyberattack on SingHealth's IT system resulted in the data of a large number of patients being illegally accessed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The cyberattack on SingHealth's IT system has resulted in the data of a large number of patients being illegally accessed.

sections.label: IHiS cybersecurity tightening measures
sections.summary: IHiS implemented measures including firewall rules, clean server images, disabling the attacker's tool, temporary Internet Surfing Separation and accelerated Client ATP deployment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Following the discovery of the cyberattack, IHiS implemented several measures to tighten cybersecurity.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: These included: (a) creating firewall rules to block further malicious callbacks to the suspected command and control servers; (b) reloading servers with clean images to eliminate any remaining presence of the attacker; (c) disabling the tool used by the attacker to enter the network; (d) implementing temporary Internet Surfing Separation (ISS) for the public healthcare sector; (e) accelerating the deployment of Client Advanced Threat Protection (ATP) to public healthcare servers and endpoint devices.

sections.label: DAM extension to healthcare clusters
sections.summary: DAM will be extended to the electronic medical record databases of all the other healthcare clusters by mid-2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: DAM will be extended to the electronic medical record databases of all the other healthcare clusters by mid-2019.

sections.label: SingHealth contacting patients
sections.summary: SingHealth contacted more than two million patients and reached around 97% of them.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: SingHealth took steps to contact more than two million patients and successfully reached around 97% of them.

sections.label: Cybersecurity risk ownership accountability
sections.summary: CAC highlighted the need for clearer cybersecurity risk ownership and accountability between IHiS and public healthcare clusters, underpinned by a strong relationship.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: CAC has highlighted the need for clearer cybersecurity risk ownership and accountability between IHiS and the public healthcare clusters, underpinned by a strong relationship to avoid fragmenting our healthcare IT strategy.

sections.label: MOH CISO support and reporting
sections.summary: The MOH CISO will be supported by a dedicated office in MOH and report to the Permanent Secretary.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The MOH CISO will be supported by a dedicated office in MOH and report to the Permanent Secretary.

sections.label: Cluster Information Security Officer reporting
sections.summary: The Cluster Information Security Officer position will be elevated to report directly to cluster management and be accountable to cluster Boards' IT and Risk Management Committees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The position of the Cluster Information Security Officer will be elevated to report directly to cluster management and be accountable to the IT and Risk Management Committees of the cluster Boards.

sections.label: Cyber Defence Group in IHiS
sections.summary: The second line of defence will be strengthened by establishing a dedicated Cyber Defence Group in IHiS headed by a senior leader.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The second line of defence comprises units and personnel who have the specific responsibility to oversee security strategy, risk management and compliance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will strengthen and elevate this second line of defence by establishing a dedicated Cyber Defence Group in IHiS headed by a senior leader at or equivalent to the Deputy Chief Executive level.

sections.label: Pilot at NUHS
sections.summary: The pilot will begin this quarter at the National University Health System.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The pilot will begin this quarter at the National University Health System (NUHS).

sections.label: Pilot conduct and evaluation
sections.summary: The conduct and evaluation of the pilot is expected to take about six months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The conduct and evaluation of the pilot is expected to take about six months.

sections.label: NEHR cybersecurity assessments
sections.summary: NEHR has undergone cybersecurity assessments by CSA, GovTech and PricewaterhouseCoopers over the past few months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Over the past few months, NEHR has been undergoing a series of cybersecurity assessments conducted by CSA, GovTech and independent firm PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC).

sections.label: NEHR testing and mandatory contribution deferral
sections.summary: NEHR will undergo further testing and reviews, and mandatory contribution of patient medical data will be deferred until reviews are completed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The NEHR system will be subject to further testing and reviews, including exercises to test its defences against targeted attacks, as well as business continuity and disaster recovery plans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: I had informed this House in August that we would be deferring plans for mandatory contribution of patient medical data to the NEHR.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: As NEHR is an important large-scale national system, we want to be fully assured that all the necessary safeguards are in place to handle the evolving cybersecurity threat landscape.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will, therefore, proceed with the introduction of the Healthcare Services Bill first, and continue to defer the NEHR mandatory contributions until we have completed these reviews.

sections.label: Termination of two employees
sections.summary: The employment of the Citrix Team Lead and the Security Incident Response Manager has been terminated.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The employment of the Citrix Team Lead and the Security Incident Response Manager has been terminated.

sections.label: IHiS Board financial penalty
sections.summary: The IHiS Board decided to impose a financial penalty on the CEO and four other senior management members.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The IHiS Board has decided to impose a financial penalty, higher than that imposed on the middle management supervisors, on the CEO and four other members of the IHiS senior management team.

sections.label: PDPC financial penalties
sections.summary: PDPC decided to impose financial penalties on IHiS and SingHealth totalling $1 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: PDPC has decided to impose financial penalties on IHiS and SingHealth, which comes to $1 million in total.

sections.label: Oversight of healthcare IT follow-up
sections.summary: Senior management from MOH, IHiS and healthcare clusters will lead efforts and report progress to the Healthcare IT Steering Committee, which oversees implementation and taps independent auditors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Senior management and key personnel from MOH, IHiS and healthcare clusters will lead these efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: They will report their progress regularly to the Healthcare IT Steering Committee chaired by my Permanent Secretary.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The Steering Committee will oversee the implementation and closely monitor its progress.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: It will also tap on independent auditors to verify the completion of the follow-up actions.

sections.label: Rising cybersecurity threat level
sections.summary: The cybersecurity landscape has shifted and the threat level has risen, so the healthcare sector's cybersecurity posture needs to be raised.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Yet, we recognise that the cybersecurity landscape has shifted and the threat level has risen.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: So, the cybersecurity posture of the healthcare sector needs to be correspondingly raised.

sections.label: Cybersecurity Act audit framework
sections.summary: The Cybersecurity Act and CSA set up audit and compliance mechanisms, with CII owners in 11 vertical sectors adhering to a Code of Practice and regular audits.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The mechanisms and the framework for doing such an audit and compliance is actually set up under the Cybersecurity Act and CSA which has oversight of the overall national cybersecurity effort, in particular, the work that is being done by the CII owners in the 11 vertical sectors, who will be the ones that oversee the execution and compliance, if you will, of the processes that are needed to continually strengthen our cybersecurity system.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: There is a Code of Practice that CII owners are expected to adhere to.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: There are provisions for regular audits, minimally once in two years but, if not, can be more frequent, if mandatorily required by CSA.

sections.label: Perpetrator identity not disclosed
sections.summary: The perpetrator's identity is known, but public attribution is not in our interest, not due to lack of legislative capacity within jurisdiction.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: If I may reiterate my earlier response: we know the identity of the perpetrator.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But it is not in our interest to make a public attribution, and it is not because we lack the legislative capacity to do so, if indeed it is within our jurisdiction.

sections.label: Review before making system mandatory
sections.summary: Because it is a large and important national system, it will be tested again before being made mandatory, with review completion expected this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: But given that it is a very large system and a very important national system, we want to be extra cautious to have it tested and tested again before we make it mandatory.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: We foresee that we will probably be able to complete our review within this year and then we can make a decision at the end of this year to see when we are ready to implement then because the process is still ongoing.

sections.label: GCIO reporting line in clusters
sections.summary: The GCIO in clusters, currently an IHiS staff, will now report to the Board and management of the cluster.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Particularly within the cluster, currently, the GCIO is an IHiS staff and, therefore, there is a question: does he have sufficient resources, does he report to IHIS or does he report to the cluster?

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: So, we have made it clear now that the GCIO in the clusters will report to the Board and the management of the cluster.

sections.label: Security reporting lines in MOH
sections.summary: The Cluster ISO reports directly to management, and MOH will set up a CISCO reporting to the Permanent Secretary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Particularly on security, the Cluster ISO now reports directly to the management, he does not report to the GCIO.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Within MOH, I mentioned that we are going to set up a separate Chief Information Security Officer (CISCO) which would report directly to the Permanent Secretary.

sections.label: Scam risk from stolen data
sections.summary: A victim could be tricked by a scam using stolen data, so the question asks why CSA said the data has no strong commercial value.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: Imagine if someone were to receive an email/SMS and now, possibly, a hardcopy letter, purportedly from SingHealth or even CSA, stating his name, National Registration Identity Card (NRIC) number, date of birth, gender, race, to name some of the stolen data, and asking that unsuspecting person to call or to go online to verity some information because someone has given him wrong medication or some innocuous matter, life is going to be hell for this person if he were to make the first contact and fall victim to the scam.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: So, my first question is, in the aftermath of the cyberattack, why did CSA say that there is no strong commercial value for such data when the danger for loss of privacy and financial for our victims of this cyberattack is clear and present?

sections.label: Data monitoring and union briefing
sections.summary: The data is being monitored with no evidence of Dark Web use, and the unions should be kept informed when disciplinary action is taken.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, first, and if I can summarise it, overall, the data, we are monitoring the situation.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: There is no evidence to date in terms of its use or emergence in the Dark Web.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: I have two questions for the Minister for Health.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: I agree with Mr Patrick Tay that it is a good practice whenever these incidents happen and we have to take disciplinary action, it is best to keep the unions informed.

sections.label: Rewarding good performance
sections.summary: Those who continue to do well should continue to get what they deserve, and their contributions will be recognised at year end.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Should they continue to do well, they should continue to get what they deserve.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: And for those who have done well, their contributions will be recognised at the end of the year.

sections.label: Testing NEHR cybersecurity defences
sections.summary: Because private operators tap into the NEHR, additional precautions are being taken to test its cybersecurity and cyber defences before requiring everyone to submit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Indeed, we are aware that there is a risk, because we have many private operators which have to tap on to our NEHR in order to submit their data, and that is why we are taking additional precautions to test our NEHR cybersecurity and cyber defences to ensure that they are robust before we require everyone to submit.

sections.label: Support for IHiS after incident
sections.summary: IHiS has reorganised and strengthened governance, its staff morale has suffered, and MOH and clusters will extend full support as it implements COI recommendations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Indeed, IHiS has been working very hard over the last few years in reorganising itself, strengthening its governance, as well as rolling out many major systems.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: But this is an important incident and it is a very critical and regrettable incident and, IHiS' staff morale has, indeed, taken a toll from this incident.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: As I have mentioned in my speech, even as they go through the reorganisation, going through the repositioning, reprioritising, MOH and all our clusters will extend our full support for them and we want to encourage them to soldier on because there are still many important tasks ahead of us, and not the least, the implementation of the recommendations of the COI.

sections.label: Unrevealed perpetrator and justice
sections.summary: The person who broke in was not revealed, leaving a vacuum in the sense of justice.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cedric Foo Chee Keng
sentences.text: However, even with recommendations on strengthening defences, the "vault", and many other areas, the person who actually "broke into the house" was not revealed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cedric Foo Chee Keng
sentences.text: There seems to be a vacuum as far as the sense of justice is concerned.

sections.label: CSA notification and press conference
sections.summary: It was brought to CSA's attention on 10 July, and on 20 July a press conference announced it to the public.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: In that regard, I would highlight a few things.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: I think it was 10 July that it was brought to the attention of CSA, and on 20 July, Minister Gan Kim Yong and I held a press conference and we announced it and shared it with members of the public.

sections.label: COI appointed for robust inquiry
sections.summary: A COI was appointed for a robust and transparent investigation, and its recommendations and material findings were released in full publicly.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Thirdly, if Members look at our response thereafter, we appointed a COI.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Because the Government wants a robust and transparent investigation and inquiry into the matter, not because we want to lay fault – although if there are, those who have been negligent or egregious, then they have to be accountable – but also because we want to learn from this, understand what went wrong and rectify them.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, if Members look at the COI report, we have released all the recommendations and material findings in full in the public version.

sections.label: Public attribution and national interests
sections.summary: Judgement is needed on whether public attribution serves national interests, and the perpetrator is known with appropriate action taken.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: I can understand that Members have a desire, and on behalf of their constituents, to know this, but I think we have to exercise judgement as to what is in our national interests and whether a public attribution serves our best interests.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: And as I have said, we know who the perpetrator is and appropriate action has been taken.
